context: Asuka lectures on revolutions in history.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: history lecture; vocabulary (革命/危機/違反/被告/外交) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 革命は、社会の危機から生まれます。
lines.en: Revolutions are born from social crises.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 危機は、どう始まるんですか?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 権力の違反が、危機を招きます。
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 革命の後、外交は変わりますか?
lines.en: Does diplomacy change after a revolution?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、革命後、外交が一新されます。
lines.en: Yes, after a revolution, diplomacy is renewed.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 指導者が、被告になることも?
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 違反を問われ、被告になった例もあります。
lines.en: There are cases of leaders charged and becoming defendants.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 革命と外交、深く関わるんですね。
lines.en: Revolution and diplomacy are deeply linked.
lines.style: moved adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
